facts.fact: 清早在主宅吃早饭——已将近七点、太阳刚起。
facts.anchor: Even though it’s nearly seven already, the sun is just starting to rise over the outbuilding roofs.

facts.fact: Harriet 说 Brooks 听说她病倒慌了神、用各种报酬求汤。
facts.anchor: When Brooks called, I thought something terrible had happened. He was so panicked—bribed me with all sorts to have me make the soup.

facts.fact: 求汤开价：一年每周带 Emmy、付大学学费、六个月尿布。
facts.anchor: Offered to take Emmy once a week for the next year. Pay for her college. Buy six months of diapers for this little guy. The works.

facts.fact: 成交价：两个月每周 babysit+一周尿布；他今早带 Emmy 去 Farrow 买菜。
facts.anchor: we settled on two months of weekly babysitting duty and a week’s worth of diapers. He’s takin’ Em to Farrow this morning to go grocery shopping.

facts.fact: 她约了 11 点左右去 Jody 家，并替妈妈带文件给 Ms. Angie。
facts.anchor: Sure. I told Jody about eleven, so I’ll be in the stables until then.

facts.fact: 骑马度假项目需要更多马+全新马厩区才不扰牧场。
facts.anchor: We’re gonna need a lot more horses and a brand-new stable block if we don’t wanna disrupt the ranch

facts.fact: 和 Jody 驯新收的一岁马进展顺利，收工时两人灰头土脸。
facts.anchor: We make great progress with a newly-acquired yearling, and by the time we call it a day, we’re both a little dusty and bedraggled

facts.fact: Jody 翻抽屉发现烙 BH 的 Brooks 钱包并当面发问——她谎称看电影睡着落下的。
facts.anchor: He’s holding a familiar piece of folded, worn tan leather with the letters BH burned into the lower right-hand corner. “Why’s Brooks’s wallet here?”

relations: Harriet 是 Tanner 家管家/做饭人
Jody 是出了名的爱乱翻（Reston 语）
